snippet.title: 20 years of Railroad Tycoon 3, how it influences us, and Developer Q&A! | CoS Podcast
snippet.description:
Hello all! This is our November Devlog, posted early for Patreons. Link below! In this episode, developers Mark and Wings & Strings discuss the significance of 20 years of Railroad Tycoon 3, and how those design elements influence "The Game" elements of Century of Steam. There's also Q&A with Patrons at the end.
